hero.title: Gokarna Beach Trek
hero.bookingText: Visit driftandwave.travel/gokarna for full details & booking

overview.text: An easy coastal trail connecting five secluded beaches along the Gokarna coastline, with cliffside camping, sunset points and warm ocean swims.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Om Beach Sunset
itinerary.description: Check in, settle into camp and catch the sunset at Om Beach.

itinerary.title: Coastal Trail to Half Moon & Paradise Beach
itinerary.description: Trek along cliffside trails connecting Half Moon and Paradise beaches, with time to swim and relax.

itinerary.title: Kudle Beach & Local Markets
itinerary.description: Morning yoga session followed by free time to explore Kudle Beach and the Gokarna town markets.

itinerary.title: Sunrise Swim & Departure
itinerary.description: Early morning swim, breakfast, and departure from Gokarna.

inclusions.title: Beach Camping
inclusions.description: Tented stays on the beach, twin sharing.

inclusions.title: Meals
inclusions.description: All meals included, local coastal cuisine.

inclusions.title: Trail Guide
inclusions.description: Local guide for all coastal trail sections.

inclusions.title: Safety
inclusions.description: First-aid and lifeguard support at all swim stops.

faqs.question: Do I need swimming experience?
faqs.answer: No, but basic water comfort is recommended for the beach-hopping sections.

faqs.question: Is this trip family-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes, the trail is easy and suitable for most fitness levels, including families with older kids.

footer.title: Drift & Wave Expeditions
footer.description: Slow travel along India's most beautiful coastlines.
